Worst experience at Imperial Suzuki, Mira Road.

Visited last week to check out some bikes. The staff had zero knowledge about their own products. I asked basic stuff like mileage, on-road price, and color options but they kept looking at each other. No proper explanation or demo. Didn’t even seem like they wanted to sell bikes.

The behavior was really bad too. No one welcomed us when we entered. Didn’t offer water or even ask us to sit. The staff was busy chatting among themselves and completely ignored us. Asked for a test ride and they just said "not available right now" without any reason or alternative.

This is an official Suzuki showroom but the service feels like some local garage. Management really needs to train their staff - they don’t know the products and don’t know how to talk to customers.

Don’t waste your time going here. Avoid this dealership until they fix their service.
